Single boiler for mostly straight espresso; heat exchanger or dual boiler for frequent milk drinks, so you can steam right after brewing. 58mm is the commercial portafilter standard. The two picks: Gaggia Classic Pro (Claude) and Breville Bambino Plus BES500 (GPT).
